author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: implementation. Role: frontend developer. Repo: a plain JavaScript storefront front end whose cart page renders from a view-model function `buildCartView(cart, options)` (items, line totals, subtotal, a shipping row, a total) with a money helper that works in minor units and formats with Intl for a locale and currency (including a zero-decimal currency and a three-decimal one). The feature: a promo code row and a free-shipping progress bar in the view-model: a code is looked up in a small catalogue module (percent off, fixed amount off, free shipping, with a minimum spend and an expiry date, one code at a time), the discount applies before shipping and tax rules the existing code already has, the progress bar says how much more to spend to reach the free-shipping threshold (a plain object with fields the request names, never HTML). Traps: rounding of a percent discount in minor units (round half away from zero on the total, not per line), a discount larger than the subtotal, expiry at a day boundary in the shop time zone given in the options, the threshold compared after the discount, the zero-decimal currency, a code with different case or surrounding spaces, and an invalid code that must show a message but keep the cart unchanged.
